findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 1, Harm 2
Raise: Not done. The summary uses only in-progress, Needs you, Stuck and go-live values, then becomes null when they are all absent. A normal board with one ready-to-merge fix and no other active work has a known `team` but opens directly at READY TO MERGE, without the Done-when summary line. The changed `tests/fixtures/board.json` contains this ready-only count pattern; a planning-only board has the same gap.
